description: InstruktAI shared Renovate preset: green non-major updates auto-merge after a 3-day release age; security fixes skip the wait.

packageRules.description: Non-major updates merge once every check on the PR is green.
Major updates wait for a human.
Lock file maintenance carries no release timestamp, so minimumReleaseAge would hold it forever; it is exempt from the age gate and therefore not auto-merged.
